insight: Models memory as a structured user profile plus an event timeline, not embedded transcript chunks like most memory layers.
name: Memobase
tagline: User profile-based long-term memory for LLM applications.
description: Memobase gives AI apps persistent, per-user memory by distilling conversations into a structured user profile and a chronological event timeline, rather than storing raw transcript embeddings. It exposes Python, Node, and Go SDKs plus a REST API and an MCP server, and is open source (Apache-2.0) with a managed cloud option. Built on FastAPI, Postgres, and Redis for low-latency retrieval.

modelSupport.notes: Plugs into your existing LLM stack; bring your own provider.
